items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: mostly from absorbing some of the Charlie Parker and the bebop saxophonists

ctx.x: I think it’s more — they maybe just used it incidentally. So who was the first person to really—

It seems like I was one of the first ones that used it kind of in the bebop way, and mostly from absorbing some of the Charlie Parker and the bebop saxophonists, and just transferring it to the flute.
Did you get into swing from the radio or just because your brother was out there doing it?
